body.zh-HK:
> 面試官問：「你的 assistant 找到兩份已獲准讀取的文件：一份說資料保留 30 日，另一份說 90 日。模型建議回答 60 日，或只選更新日期較近的一份。你會怎樣設計安全回應？」
>
> 答啱一半嘅答案：「選最新文件；如果不確定，就取兩個數字的中間值。」

## 矛盾不是一個平均數問題

兩份文字看似衝突，可能其實描述不同 subject、資料類型、司法管轄區、產品、effective period 或 exception。也可能真的是文件過期、發布錯誤或 policy owner 尚未完成更新。模型把兩段語句混成一個流暢答案，並不會產生一條合法的規則。特別是「60 日」這種平均，既未被任何來源支持，也令讀者不知道自己應跟誰確認。

先將每條可操作 statement 正規化成小型 record：主體／資料類型、predicate、數值或規則、範圍、source ID、source owner、版本、發布與生效日期、jurisdiction、exception 和 authority level。再比較是否同一個 decision key。若只是不同 scope，UI 可以清楚顯示兩種情況；若在同一 decision key 下互相矛盾，系統應標記 conflict、返回證據和 owner，而非選一段模型較喜歡的文字。最新版本可能值得較高 priority，但只有預先定義的 authority rule 和 source owner 才能決定它是否取代舊規則。

## 兩個關門時間不能取平均

商場門口一塊牌說星期日六點關，另一塊牌說八點關。你不會說「那就七點」；你會看日期、看看是不是不同樓層，再找負責的店長確認。模型可以幫你把兩塊牌放在一起，卻不能因句子更流暢而成為店長。

## 答案在哪裡會變薄

不要一遇到矛盾就把它丟進一個會自動做決定的 agent。最小 baseline 是一份有 owner 的 canonical source，加上明確寫出的 scope。對超出範圍的問題，返回「不在本工具可確認的來源內」。只有當多來源真的必不可少，才增加 conflict detector、authority matrix 和 review queue。

## 技術判斷：先比 decision key，再談摘要

建立一個結構化 comparison：同一 subject、field、scope、effective time 和 jurisdiction 才可視為同一 decision key。將有效日期、authority level 和 supersedes relation 寫入 manifest，而不是藏在 prompt。測試至少包括：不同資料類型但看似衝突；同 scope、不同版本、明確標示 superseded；同 scope、同時有效的真衝突；來源缺少 owner；以及模型想平均兩個數字的輸出。expected outcome 要分成 disambiguated、use_authoritative_source、conflict_needs_owner 或 insufficient_metadata。

source conflict 不等於模型錯誤；它是資料品質和治理狀態。記錄每次 conflict detection 的 source IDs、版本、comparison rule 和 outcome，讓 policy 更新後可以重跑。絕不可把受限文件原文複製到公開 issue 或 demo log。

## 工程層面：把 unresolved 明確做成一個 state

生成前，service 先解析並比對 evidence records；發現衝突便產生一份 conflict packet，只有安全 metadata、引用位置、owner 和問題，不需讓模型揣測規則。生成後，validator 檢查 answer 不能說出 manifest 未支持的數值，也不能把 conflict status 偽裝成 resolved。UI 可顯示「需要 policy owner 確認」、「適用於 A，不適用於 B」或「來源資訊不足」。這比一句含糊的 apologetic answer 更能讓使用者採取下一步。

resolution 也要會過期：owner 的決定應有 decision ID、有效日期、review date 和關聯版本。否則舊的人手判斷會悄悄變成沒有來源的永久 policy。

## 交付、業務與風險：必須有一個能改規則的人

模型、工程師和 support 不應默認擁有 policy interpretation 的最終權。指定 source／policy owner、review SLA、緊急暫停方式和使用者訊息的責任人。量度 conflict rate、缺 owner 的來源、解決時間、重開比例、過期 decision 的數量和因資料不足而安全停止的 case。這些指標可能短期看起來不漂亮，但比一個假裝全知的 assistant 更可靠。

## 可放進 portfolio 的 artefact

建立 conflicting-sources-handoff-lab：

- fixtures/source-records.json：完全合成、可版本化的 policy statements 和 source owner metadata。
- docs/decision-key.md：怎樣比較 subject、field、scope、effective time 和 jurisdiction。
- tests/conflict-matrix.md：不同 scope、superseded、真衝突、缺 owner、模型平均數等預期狀態。
- fixtures/conflict-packets.json：只保留 source IDs、span、owner、版本和 review question。
- docs/authority-matrix.md：哪個 source type 可取代哪個 source type，以及誰可確認例外。

## 延伸閱讀

[Structured output 不是 grounding check](/zh-HK/interview-lab/structured-output-is-not-a-grounding-check)、[KEV Review Packet：公開資料的證據鏈](/zh-HK/articles/build-a-public-data-kev-review-packet) 和 [由含糊需求走到可驗收功能](/zh-HK/articles/from-vague-request-to-accepted-feature)。

## 範圍說明

這是 AI.DOG 的單題練習。政策、時限、owner、文件與結果全屬虛構或 synthetic fixture；它不是法律、私隱、保留期或合規意見，亦不代表任何公司的內部規則。

> 面试官问：“你的 assistant 找到两份已获准读取的文件：一份说数据保留 30 日，另一份说 90 日。模型建议回答 60 日，或只选更新日期较近的一份。你会怎样设计安全回应？”
>
> 答对一半的回答：“选最新文件；若不确定，就取两个数字的中间值。”

## 矛盾不是平均数问题

两份文字看似冲突，可能其实描述不同 subject、资料类型、司法管辖区、产品、effective period 或 exception；也可能真是文件过期、发布错误，或 policy owner 尚未完成更新。模型将两段文字混成一个流畅答案，不会产生一条合法规则。尤其“60 日”这种平均，既没有任何来源支持，也让读者不知道该向谁确认。

先将每个可操作 statement 正规化成小 record：主体／资料类型、predicate、数值或规则、范围、source ID、source owner、版本、发布与生效日期、jurisdiction、exception 和 authority level。再比较是否同一个 decision key。若只是不同 scope，UI 可以清楚显示两种情况；若在同一 decision key 下矛盾，系统应标记 conflict、返回证据与 owner，而不是挑一段模型更喜欢的文字。最新版本也许优先，但只有预先定义的 authority rule 和 source owner 才能决定它是否取代旧规则。

## 两个关门时间不能取平均

商场门口一块牌说周日六点关，另一块说八点关。你不会说“那就七点”；你会看日期、确认是否不同楼层，再找负责店长。模型能把两块牌放在一起，却不能因为句子更流畅而成为店长。

## 答案容易在哪儿变薄

不要一遇到矛盾就交给会自动决策的 agent。最小 baseline 是一份有 owner 的 canonical source，加上明确 scope。对范围外问题，回应“不在本工具可确认的来源内”。只有多来源确实不可少时，再加入 conflict detector、authority matrix 和 review queue。

## 技术判断：先比 decision key，再谈摘要

建立结构化 comparison：同一 subject、field、scope、effective time 和 jurisdiction 才能视为同一 decision key。将有效日期、authority level 和 supersedes relation 写入 manifest，而不是藏在 prompt。测试至少有：不同资料类型却看似冲突；同 scope、不同版本且明确 superseded；同 scope、同时有效的真冲突；来源缺 owner；以及模型想平均两个数字的输出。expected outcome 可分 disambiguated、use_authoritative_source、conflict_needs_owner 或 insufficient_metadata。

source conflict 不等于模型错误；它是数据质量与治理状态。记录每次 conflict detection 的 source IDs、版本、comparison rule 和 outcome，让 policy 更新后可以重跑。不可将受限文件原文复制进公开 issue 或 demo log。

## 工程层面：把 unresolved 做成明确 state

生成前，service 先解析并比对 evidence records；发现冲突就建立 conflict packet，只放安全 metadata、引用位置、owner 和问题，不让模型猜规则。生成后，validator 要检查 answer 不能说出 manifest 未支持的数值，也不能把 conflict status 伪装成 resolved。UI 可显示“需要 policy owner 确认”、“适用于 A，不适用于 B”或“来源信息不足”。这比一句模糊道歉更能让用户采取下一步。

resolution 也会过期：owner 的决定应有 decision ID、有效日期、review date 和关联版本。否则旧人工判断会悄悄变成没有来源的永久 policy。

## 交付、业务与风险：必须有人能改规则

模型、工程师和 support 不应默认拥有 policy interpretation 的最终权。要指定 source／policy owner、review SLA、紧急暂停方式和用户消息的负责人。量度 conflict rate、缺 owner 来源、解决时间、重开比例、过期 decision 数量和因资料不足而安全停止的 case。这些数字短期未必漂亮，却比假装全知的 assistant 更可靠。

- fixtures/source-records.json：完全合成、可版本化的 policy statements 和 source owner metadata。
- docs/decision-key.md：说明如何比较 subject、field、scope、effective time 和 jurisdiction。
- tests/conflict-matrix.md：不同 scope、superseded、真冲突、缺 owner、模型平均数等预期状态。
- fixtures/conflict-packets.json：只保留 source IDs、span、owner、版本和 review question。

## 范围说明

这是 AI.DOG 的单题练习。政策、时限、owner、文件和结果均为虚构或 synthetic fixture；它不是法律、隐私、保留期或合规意见，也不代表任何公司的内部规则。
body.en:
> Interviewer asks: “Your assistant finds two readable documents: one says data is retained for 30 days and another says 90. The model proposes 60 days, or selecting the document with the newer date. How would you design a safe response?”
>
> Half-right answer: “Choose the newest document; if uncertain, take the midpoint.”

## A conflict is not an averaging problem

Two passages that appear to conflict may describe different subjects, data classes, jurisdictions, products, effective periods, or exceptions. They may also be genuinely inconsistent because a document is stale, published in error, or awaiting an owner update. Combining the sentences into a fluent answer does not create a valid rule. In particular, “60 days” is supported by neither source and leaves a reader without anyone to confirm it with.

Normalise each actionable statement into a small record: subject or data class, predicate, value or rule, scope, source ID, source owner, version, publication and effective dates, jurisdiction, exception, and authority level. Then compare whether the statements share a decision key. If their scopes differ, the UI can display that distinction. If they conflict under the same decision key, the system should mark a conflict and return the evidence and owner—not choose the wording the model prefers. A newer version may earn priority, but only a pre-defined authority rule and source owner can say that it supersedes the old one.

## Two closing times cannot be averaged

One sign at a shopping centre says Sunday closing is six; another says eight. You would not say “then it is seven”. You would check the dates, see whether they apply to different floors, and ask the manager responsible. A model can place the signs together; fluent wording does not make it the manager.

## Where an answer goes thin

Do not hand every conflict to an agent that resolves rules automatically. The minimum baseline is a canonical source with a named owner and an explicit scope. For questions outside that scope, say that the source available to the tool cannot confirm the answer. Add a conflict detector, authority matrix, and review queue only when multiple sources are truly required.

## Technical judgement: compare decision keys before summarising

Use structured comparison. Only the same subject, field, scope, effective time, and jurisdiction belong to one decision key. Put effective dates, authority level, and supersedes relationships in the manifest rather than hiding them in the prompt. Tests should include apparently conflicting documents about different data types; the same scope with different versions and an explicit supersedes flag; a genuine same-scope conflict; a source with no owner; and a model output that averages two numbers. Expected outcomes can be disambiguated, use_authoritative_source, conflict_needs_owner, or insufficient_metadata.

A source conflict is not necessarily a model defect; it is a data-quality and governance state. Retain source IDs, versions, comparison rule, and outcome for every detection so the same case can be rerun after a policy update. Never copy restricted document text into a public issue or demo log.

## Engineering implementation: make unresolved a first-class state

Before generation, the service parses and compares evidence records. On a conflict it creates a conflict packet with only safe metadata, citation locations, owner, and question; it does not ask the model to invent a rule. After generation, a validator prevents an answer from naming a number unsupported by the manifest or presenting a conflict as resolved. A UI can say “policy-owner confirmation required”, “applies to A but not B”, or “source metadata insufficient”. Those are actionable states, not weak apologies.

A resolution must expire too. An owner's decision should have a decision ID, effective date, review date, and linked source version. Otherwise an old human answer quietly becomes a permanent policy without evidence.

## Delivery, business, and risk

A model, engineer, or support representative should not silently acquire final authority over policy interpretation. Name the source or policy owner, review SLA, emergency pause path, and owner of the user-facing message. Measure conflict rate, sources without owners, time to resolution, reopen rate, expired decisions, and cases that stop safely for insufficient evidence. Those measures may look uncomfortable in the short term, but they are more useful than an assistant that pretends to know every rule.

## A portfolio artefact someone can inspect

Build conflicting-sources-handoff-lab with:

- fixtures/source-records.json: fully synthetic, versioned policy statements and source-owner metadata.
- docs/decision-key.md: how subject, field, scope, effective time, and jurisdiction are compared.
- tests/conflict-matrix.md: expected states for different scopes, superseded content, genuine conflicts, missing owner, and model averages.
- fixtures/conflict-packets.json: only source IDs, spans, owner, version, and review question.
- docs/authority-matrix.md: which source types can supersede others and who may confirm an exception.

## Further reading

[Structured output is not a grounding check](/en/interview-lab/structured-output-is-not-a-grounding-check), [the KEV Review Packet evidence chain](/en/articles/build-a-public-data-kev-review-packet), and [move from a vague request to an accepted feature](/en/articles/from-vague-request-to-accepted-feature).

## Scope note

This is an AI.DOG single-question practice exercise. Its policies, periods, owners, documents, and results are fictional or synthetic fixtures. It is not legal, privacy, retention, or compliance advice, and it does not represent an organisation's internal rules.
